Check if the room state file exists. Check if the room state file is readable. Read the file to check if the current state string is exactly vacant. Check if the number of guests is greater than 0. Check if the number of guests is less than 5. Check if the maintenance flag file exists, rejecting the booking if it does. Example input: room 42, 2 guests. Example output: room 42 successfully booked.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u

STATE_DIR="${HOTEL_STATE_DIR:-./rooms}"

state_file() { printf '%s/room_%s.state\n' "$STATE_DIR" "$1"; }
maint_file() { printf '%s/room_%s.maint\n' "$STATE_DIR" "$1"; }

is_number() {
    local value="$1"
    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    case "$value" in
        *[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
    esac
    return 0
}

init_room() {
    local room="$1"
    if ! is_number "$room"; then
        printf 'invalid room number: %s\n' "$room" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    if [[ ! -d "$STATE_DIR" ]]; then
        mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR" || return 1
    fi
    printf 'vacant\n' > "$(state_file "$room")"
    printf 'room %s initialised as vacant\n' "$room"
}

book() {
    local room="$1" guests="$2" file maint state
    if ! is_number "$room"; then
        printf 'invalid room number: %s\n' "$room" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    if ! is_number "$guests"; then
        printf 'invalid guest count: %s\n' "$guests" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    if [[ "$room" -le 0 ]]; then
        printf 'room number must be greater than 0\n' >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$room" -ge 500 ]]; then
        printf 'room number must be less than 500\n' >&2
        return 1
    fi
    file="$(state_file "$room")"
    if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
        printf 'no state file for room %s\n' "$room" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -r "$file" ]]; then
        printf 'state file for room %s is not readable\n' "$room" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    maint="$(maint_file "$room")"
    if [[ -e "$maint" ]]; then
        printf 'room %s is under maintenance\n' "$room" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    IFS= read -r state < "$file" || state=""
    if [[ "$state" != "vacant" ]]; then
        printf 'room %s is not vacant (state: %s)\n' "$room" "$state" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$guests" -le 0 ]]; then
        printf 'guest count must be greater than 0\n' >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$guests" -ge 5 ]]; then
        printf 'guest count must be less than 5\n' >&2
        return 1
    fi
    printf 'booked:%s\n' "$guests" > "$file"
    printf 'room %s successfully booked\n' "$room"
}

status() {
    local room="$1" file maint state
    if ! is_number "$room"; then
        printf 'invalid room number: %s\n' "$room" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    file="$(state_file "$room")"
    if [[ ! -r "$file" ]]; then
        printf 'room %s: unknown\n' "$room"
        return 1
    fi
    maint="$(maint_file "$room")"
    if [[ -e "$maint" ]]; then
        printf 'room %s: maintenance\n' "$room"
        return 0
    fi
    IFS= read -r state < "$file" || state=""
    printf 'room %s: %s\n' "$room" "$state"
}

main() {
    if [[ "$#" -lt 1 ]]; then
        printf 'usage: %s {init ROOM|book ROOM GUESTS|status ROOM}\n' "$0" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    local cmd="$1"
    shift
    case "$cmd" in
        init)
            if [[ "$#" -ne 1 ]]; then
                printf 'usage: init ROOM\n' >&2
                return 2
            fi
            init_room "$1"
            ;;
        book)
            if [[ "$#" -ne 2 ]]; then
                printf 'usage: book ROOM GUESTS\n' >&2
                return 2
            fi
            book "$1" "$2"
            ;;
        status)
            if [[ "$#" -ne 1 ]]; then
                printf 'usage: status ROOM\n' >&2
                return 2
            fi
            status "$1"
            ;;
        *)
            printf 'unknown command: %s\n' "$cmd" >&2
            return 2
            ;;
    esac
}

main "$@"

text_es: Manage library checkouts by implementing `checkout(book, user)`. Check if the user identifier is not empty. Check if the user status file exists. Check if the user status file contains the exact string active. Check if the user owes fines greater than 0. Check if the book inventory file exists. Check if the book file has a size greater than 0. Check if the book status is exactly available. Check if the transaction log directory is writable. Example input: an active user with 0 fines checking out an available book. Example output: checkout successful.
text_nat:
LIBRARY_ROOT="${LIBRARY_ROOT:-./library}"
USER_DIR="$LIBRARY_ROOT/users"
BOOK_DIR="$LIBRARY_ROOT/books"
LOG_DIR="$LIBRARY_ROOT/log"

read_field() {
    local file="$1" key="$2" line value
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        if [[ "${line%%:*}" = "$key" ]]; then
            value="${line#*:}"
            printf '%s\n' "${value# }"
            return 0
        fi
    done < "$file"
    return 1
}

user_fines() {
    local file="$1" fines
    fines="$(read_field "$file" fines)"
    if [[ -z "$fines" ]]; then
        printf '0\n'
        return 0
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$fines"
}

checkout() {
    local book="$1" user="$2"
    local user_file="$USER_DIR/$user.status"
    local book_file="$BOOK_DIR/$book.inv"
    local status fines book_status

    if [[ -z "$user" ]]; then
        echo "error: user identifier is empty" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -f "$user_file" ]]; then
        echo "error: no status file for user '$user'" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    status="$(read_field "$user_file" status)"
    if [[ "$status" != "active" ]]; then
        echo "error: user '$user' is not active" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    fines="$(user_fines "$user_file")"
    if [[ "$fines" -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "error: user '$user' owes fines: $fines" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -f "$book_file" ]]; then
        echo "error: no inventory file for book '$book'" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -s "$book_file" ]]; then
        echo "error: inventory file for '$book' is empty" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    book_status="$(read_field "$book_file" status)"
    if [[ "$book_status" != "available" ]]; then
        echo "error: book '$book' is not available" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -w "$LOG_DIR" ]]; then
        echo "error: transaction log directory '$LOG_DIR' is not writable" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    printf '%s\tcheckout\t%s\t%s\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')" "$book" "$user" \
        >> "$LOG_DIR/transactions.log"
    printf 'status: checked-out\nborrower: %s\n' "$user" > "$book_file"
    echo "checkout successful"
}

main() {
    mkdir -p "$USER_DIR" "$BOOK_DIR" "$LOG_DIR"
    printf 'status: active\nfines: 0\n' > "$USER_DIR/alice.status"
    printf 'status: available\ntitle: Dune\n' > "$BOOK_DIR/dune.inv"
    checkout dune alice
}

main "$@"

text_es: Validate passenger boarding passes with `board(passenger)`. Check if the passenger name string is not empty. Check if the flight number is exactly the current departing flight string. Check if the seat class is exactly first. Check if the passenger bag count is greater than 0. Check if the bag count is less than 4. Check if the boarding log file exists. Check if the log file is writable. Check if the security clearance string is exactly cleared. Example input: a valid passenger boarding the current flight with 1 bag. Example output: passenger cleared for boarding.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Boarding pass validation for the current departing flight.
# A boarding pass is a '|' separated record:
#   name|flight|seat class|bag count|security clearance

set -u

CURRENT_FLIGHT="QF412"
BOARDING_LOG="${BOARDING_LOG:-/tmp/boarding.log}"

is_count() {
    case "$1" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
    esac
    return 0
}

log_event() {
    printf '%s %s\n' "$(date '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')" "$1" >>"$BOARDING_LOG"
}

reject() {
    local name="$1" reason="$2"
    if [[ -z "$name" ]]; then
        name="<unnamed>"
    fi
    printf '%s denied boarding: %s\n' "$name" "$reason" >&2
    return 1
}

board() {
    local name flight seat_class bags clearance extra
    IFS='|' read -r name flight seat_class bags clearance extra <<<"$1"

    if [[ -n "$extra" ]]; then
        reject "$name" "malformed boarding pass"
        return
    fi
    if [[ -z "$name" ]]; then
        reject "$name" "passenger name is empty"
        return
    fi
    if [[ "$flight" != "$CURRENT_FLIGHT" ]]; then
        reject "$name" "flight $flight is not the departing flight $CURRENT_FLIGHT"
        return
    fi
    if [[ "$seat_class" != "first" ]]; then
        reject "$name" "seat class $seat_class is not first"
        return
    fi
    if ! is_count "$bags"; then
        reject "$name" "bag count $bags is not a number"
        return
    fi
    if [[ "$bags" -le 0 ]]; then
        reject "$name" "no bags checked in"
        return
    fi
    if [[ "$bags" -ge 4 ]]; then
        reject "$name" "too many bags ($bags)"
        return
    fi
    if [[ ! -f "$BOARDING_LOG" ]]; then
        reject "$name" "boarding log $BOARDING_LOG is missing"
        return
    fi
    if [[ ! -w "$BOARDING_LOG" ]]; then
        reject "$name" "boarding log $BOARDING_LOG is not writable"
        return
    fi
    if [[ "$clearance" != "cleared" ]]; then
        reject "$name" "security clearance is $clearance"
        return
    fi

    log_event "$name boarded $flight with $bags bag(s)"
    printf '%s cleared for boarding.\n' "$name"
}

main() {
    if [[ ! -e "$BOARDING_LOG" ]]; then
        touch "$BOARDING_LOG"
    fi

    local passengers=(
        "Ada Lovelace|QF412|first|1|cleared"
        "Grace Hopper|QF412|economy|2|cleared"
        "Alan Turing|QF412|first|5|cleared"
    )
    local pass boarded=0 denied=0
    for pass in "${passengers[@]}"; do
        if board "$pass"; then
            boarded=$((boarded + 1))
        else
            denied=$((denied + 1))
        fi
    done

    printf 'boarded %d passenger(s) on %s\n' "$boarded" "$CURRENT_FLIGHT"
    if [[ "$denied" -gt 0 ]]; then
        printf 'denied %d passenger(s)\n' "$denied" >&2
    fi
}

main "$@"

text_es: Queue barista orders via a function called `queue(drink, size)`. Check if the drink type is exactly espresso. Check if the size string is exactly large. Check if the order quantity is greater than 0. Check if the quantity is less than 10. Check if the daily inventory file exists. Check if the inventory file is readable. Check if the machine status string is exactly ready. Check if the store status is exactly open. Example input: espresso, large. Example output: large espresso added to queue.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Barista order queue: validates the drink, the store/machine state and stock
# before an order is accepted.

INVENTORY_FILE="${INVENTORY_FILE:-/tmp/barista_inventory.txt}"
MACHINE_STATUS="${MACHINE_STATUS:-ready}"
STORE_STATUS="${STORE_STATUS:-open}"
QUEUE=()

reject() {
    printf 'order rejected: %s\n' "$1" >&2
}

check_store() {
    if [[ "$STORE_STATUS" != "open" ]]; then
        reject "store is $STORE_STATUS"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$MACHINE_STATUS" != "ready" ]]; then
        reject "machine is $MACHINE_STATUS"
        return 1
    fi
}

check_inventory_file() {
    if [[ ! -f "$INVENTORY_FILE" ]]; then
        reject "no inventory for today ($INVENTORY_FILE)"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -r "$INVENTORY_FILE" ]]; then
        reject "inventory file is not readable"
        return 1
    fi
}

check_quantity() {
    local qty="$1"
    case "$qty" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) reject "quantity '$qty' is not a number"; return 1 ;;
    esac
    if [[ "$qty" -le 0 ]]; then
        reject "quantity must be greater than 0"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$qty" -ge 10 ]]; then
        reject "quantity must be less than 10"
        return 1
    fi
}

stock_for() {
    local drink="$1" name count
    while read -r name count; do
        if [[ "$name" == "$drink" ]]; then
            printf '%s\n' "$count"
            return 0
        fi
    done < "$INVENTORY_FILE"
    printf '0\n'
}

queue() {
    local drink="$1" size="$2" qty="${3:-1}" stock
    if [[ "$drink" != "espresso" ]]; then
        reject "we only brew espresso, not '$drink'"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$size" != "large" ]]; then
        reject "size '$size' is not served"
        return 1
    fi
    check_quantity "$qty" || return 1
    check_store || return 1
    check_inventory_file || return 1
    stock=$(stock_for "$drink")
    if [[ "$stock" -lt "$qty" ]]; then
        reject "only $stock $drink shots left"
        return 1
    fi
    QUEUE+=("$size $drink x$qty")
    printf '%s %s added to queue\n' "$size" "$drink"
}

report_queue() {
    if [[ "${#QUEUE[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
        printf 'queue is empty\n'
        return 0
    fi
    printf 'pending orders:\n'
    printf '  %s\n' "${QUEUE[@]}"
}

if [[ ! -e "$INVENTORY_FILE" ]]; then
    printf 'espresso 8\nlatte 5\n' > "$INVENTORY_FILE"
fi

queue "${1:-espresso}" "${2:-large}" "${3:-1}"
report_queue

        ''|*[!0-9]*) reject "quantity '$qty' is not a number"; return 1 ;;
    esac
    if [ "$qty" -le 0 ]; then
        reject "quantity must be greater than 0"
        return 1
    fi
    if [ "$qty" -ge 10 ]; then
        reject "quantity must be less than 10"
        return 1
    fi
}

stock_for() {
    local drink="$1" name count
    while read -r name count; do
        if [ "$name" == "$drink" ]; then
            printf '%s\n' "$count"
            return 0
        fi
    done < "$INVENTORY_FILE"
    printf '0\n'
}

queue() {
    local drink="$1" size="$2" qty="${3:-1}" stock
    if [ "$drink" != "espresso" ]; then
        reject "we only brew espresso, not '$drink'"
        return 1
    fi
    if [ "$size" != "large" ]; then
        reject "size '$size' is not served"
        return 1
    fi
    check_quantity "$qty" || return 1
    check_store || return 1
    check_inventory_file || return 1
    stock=$(stock_for "$drink")
    if [ "$stock" -lt "$qty" ]; then
        reject "only $stock $drink shots left"
        return 1
    fi
    QUEUE+=("$size $drink x$qty")
    printf '%s %s added to queue\n' "$size" "$drink"
}

report_queue() {
    if [ "${#QUEUE[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
        printf 'queue is empty\n'
        return 0
    fi
    printf 'pending orders:\n'
    printf '  %s\n' "${QUEUE[@]}"
}

if [ ! -e "$INVENTORY_FILE" ]; then
    printf 'espresso 8\nlatte 5\n' > "$INVENTORY_FILE"
fi

queue "${1:-espresso}" "${2:-large}" "${3:-1}"
report_queue

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Movie ticket issuing module.
set -u

PRINTER_DEV="${PRINTER_DEV:-/dev/null}"
SEAT_NUMBER="${SEAT_NUMBER:-50}"
SHOWTIME_EPOCH="${SHOWTIME_EPOCH:-$(( $(date +%s) + 3600 ))}"

rating_of() {
    case "$1" in
        "Sinister Halls"|"Blood Harvest"|"Night Shift") echo "restricted" ;;
        "Gentle Rain"|"The Long Walk Home") echo "general" ;;
        *) echo "unrated" ;;
    esac
}

is_positive_int() {
    local value="$1"
    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ -n "${value//[0-9]/}" ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$value" -le 0 ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

check_seat() {
    local seat="$1"
    if ! is_positive_int "$seat"; then
        echo "error: seat number must be greater than 0" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$seat" -ge 300 ]]; then
        echo "error: seat number $seat is outside the auditorium (max 299)" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

check_printer() {
    if [[ ! -e "$PRINTER_DEV" ]]; then
        echo "error: printer device $PRINTER_DEV does not exist" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -w "$PRINTER_DEV" ]]; then
        echo "error: printer device $PRINTER_DEV is not writable" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

print_ticket() {
    local movie="$1" age="$2" seat="$3" rating="$4"
    if ! printf 'TICKET\n movie: %s\n rating: %s\n age: %s\n seat: %s\n' \
        "$movie" "$rating" "$age" "$seat" >"$PRINTER_DEV"; then
        echo "error: printing failed on $PRINTER_DEV" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

issue() {
    local movie="$1" age="$2" rating now
    if [[ -z "$movie" ]]; then
        echo "error: movie title must not be empty" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if ! is_positive_int "$age"; then
        echo "error: buyer age must be greater than 0" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    rating="$(rating_of "$movie")"
    if [[ "$rating" = "restricted" ]]; then
        if [[ "$age" -lt 17 ]]; then
            echo "denied: $movie is restricted, buyer is $age" >&2
            return 1
        fi
    fi
    check_seat "$SEAT_NUMBER" || return 1
    check_printer || return 1
    now="$(date +%s)"
    if [[ "$now" -ge "$SHOWTIME_EPOCH" ]]; then
        echo "denied: showtime for $movie has already passed" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    print_ticket "$movie" "$age" "$SEAT_NUMBER" "$rating" || return 1
    echo "ticket issued for seat $SEAT_NUMBER"
    return 0
}

main() {
    if [[ "$#" -lt 2 ]]; then
        echo "usage: $0 MOVIE AGE [SEAT]" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    if [[ "$#" -ge 3 ]]; then
        SEAT_NUMBER="$3"
    fi
    issue "$1" "$2"
}

main "$@"

text_es: Aggregate daily weather reports using `aggregate(station)`. Check if the station identifier is not empty. Check if the report file for the station exists. Check if the report file has a size greater than 0. Read the temperature and check if it is less than 0. Check if the temperature is greater than 40. Check if the weather condition string is exactly snow. Check if the central log directory exists. Check if the directory is writable. Example input: a valid station reporting snow at -5 degrees. Example output: freezing conditions recorded.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Aggregate daily weather reports stored as "<temperature> <condition>" lines.

REPORT_DIR="${REPORT_DIR:-./reports}"
LOG_DIR="${LOG_DIR:-./logs}"

is_integer() {
    local value="$1"
    case "$value" in
        -*) value="${value#-}" ;;
    esac
    case "$value" in
        '' | *[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
    esac
    return 0
}

ensure_log_dir() {
    if [[ ! -d "$LOG_DIR" ]]; then
        mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" || return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -w "$LOG_DIR" ]]; then
        echo "error: log directory '$LOG_DIR' is not writable" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

aggregate() {
    local station="$1"
    if [[ -z "$station" ]]; then
        echo "error: station identifier is empty" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    local report="$REPORT_DIR/$station.txt"
    if [[ ! -f "$report" ]]; then
        echo "error: no report file for station '$station'" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -s "$report" ]]; then
        echo "error: report file for station '$station' is empty" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    local days=0 freezing=0 heat=0 snow=0 temp condition
    while read -r temp condition _; do
        if ! is_integer "$temp"; then
            echo "warning: skipping malformed temperature '$temp'" >&2
            continue
        fi
        days=$((days + 1))
        if [[ "$temp" -lt 0 ]]; then
            freezing=$((freezing + 1))
        fi
        if [[ "$temp" -gt 40 ]]; then
            heat=$((heat + 1))
        fi
        if [[ "$condition" = "snow" ]]; then
            snow=$((snow + 1))
        fi
    done < "$report"

    if [[ "$days" -eq 0 ]]; then
        echo "error: no usable records for station '$station'" >&2
        return 1
    fi

    ensure_log_dir || return 1
    printf '%s days=%d freezing=%d heat=%d snow=%d\n' \
        "$station" "$days" "$freezing" "$heat" "$snow" >> "$LOG_DIR/aggregate.log"

    if [[ "$freezing" -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "freezing conditions recorded"
    fi
    if [[ "$heat" -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "heat warning recorded"
    fi
    if [[ "$snow" -gt 0 ]]; then
        echo "snowfall on $snow of $days day(s)"
    fi
    return 0
}

main() {
    if [[ "$#" -eq 0 ]]; then
        echo "usage: ${0##*/} <station> [station ...]" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    local status=0 station
    for station in "$@"; do
        aggregate "$station" || status=1
    done
    return "$status"
}

main "$@"

text_es: Manage greenhouse watering schedules with the function `water(plant)`. Check if the plant identifier is not empty. Check if the plant history file exists. Check if the history file is readable. Check if the soil moisture integer is less than 30. Check if the moisture is greater than 80. Check if the plant type string is exactly succulent. Check if the elapsed days since last watering is greater than 7. Check if the water pump device is ready. Example input: a succulent with moisture level 20. Example output: watering scheduled for plant.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Greenhouse watering scheduler.
# Each plant has a history file $HISTORY_DIR/<plant>.log whose last record is
#   "<type> <moisture> <days-since-last-watering>"
# The pump reports its state in $PUMP_STATE_FILE ("ready" / "busy" / "fault").

HISTORY_DIR="${HISTORY_DIR:-./plant_history}"
PUMP_STATE_FILE="${PUMP_STATE_FILE:-./pump.state}"

is_int() {
    case "$1" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
    esac
    return 0
}

read_last_record() {
    local line
    line=$(tail -n 1 "$1")
    if [[ -z "$line" ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    read -r REC_TYPE REC_MOISTURE REC_ELAPSED <<<"$line"
    if ! is_int "$REC_MOISTURE"; then
        return 1
    fi
    if ! is_int "$REC_ELAPSED"; then
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

pump_ready() {
    if [[ ! -r "$PUMP_STATE_FILE" ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    local state
    state=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$PUMP_STATE_FILE")
    if [[ "$state" = "ready" ]]; then
        return 0
    fi
    return 1
}

water() {
    local plant="$1"
    if [[ -z "$plant" ]]; then
        echo "error: empty plant identifier" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    local hist="$HISTORY_DIR/$plant.log"
    if [[ ! -f "$hist" ]]; then
        echo "error: no history file for plant $plant" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    if [[ ! -r "$hist" ]]; then
        echo "error: history of plant $plant is not readable" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    if ! read_last_record "$hist"; then
        echo "error: malformed history record for plant $plant" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    if [[ "$REC_MOISTURE" -gt 80 ]]; then
        echo "plant $plant skipped: soil saturated ($REC_MOISTURE%)"
        return 1
    fi
    local needs="no"
    if [[ "$REC_MOISTURE" -lt 30 ]]; then
        needs="yes"
    fi
    if [[ "$REC_TYPE" = "succulent" ]]; then
        if [[ "$REC_ELAPSED" -le 7 ]]; then
            needs="no"
        fi
    fi
    if [[ "$needs" = "no" ]]; then
        echo "plant $plant skipped: no watering needed ($REC_MOISTURE%, $REC_ELAPSED days)"
        return 1
    fi
    if ! pump_ready; then
        echo "error: water pump not ready for plant $plant" >&2
        return 3
    fi
    if [[ -w "$hist" ]]; then
        echo "$REC_TYPE $REC_MOISTURE 0" >> "$hist"
    fi
    echo "watering scheduled for plant $plant"
    return 0
}

main() {
    if [[ ! -d "$HISTORY_DIR" ]]; then
        echo "error: history directory $HISTORY_DIR missing" >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    local plants=("$@") f p rc=0
    if [[ "$#" -eq 0 ]]; then
        for f in "$HISTORY_DIR"/*.log; do
            if [[ -f "$f" ]]; then
                plants+=("$(basename "$f" .log)")
            fi
        done
    fi
    for p in "${plants[@]}"; do
        if ! water "$p"; then
            rc=1
        fi
    done
    exit "$rc"
}

main "$@"

text_es: Control gym turnstiles using the function `access(token, zone)`. Check if the scanning token is not empty. Check if the member profile file exists. Check if the profile file has a size greater than 0. Read the file to check if the membership status is exactly active. Check if the outstanding dues integer is exactly 0. Check if the requested zone is exactly pool. Check if the entry log file exists. Check if the log file is writable. Example input: an active member requesting access to the pool. Example output: access granted.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Gym turnstile access control.
set -u

PROFILE_DIR="${PROFILE_DIR:-/var/lib/gym/profiles}"
ACCESS_LOG="${ACCESS_LOG:-/var/log/gym/turnstile.log}"

get_field() {
    local file="$1" key="$2" k v
    while IFS='=' read -r k v; do
        if [[ "$k" = "$key" ]]; then
            printf '%s\n' "$v"
            return 0
        fi
    done < "$file"
    return 1
}

log_entry() {
    local token="$1" verdict="$2" detail="$3"
    if [[ ! -f "$ACCESS_LOG" ]]; then
        touch "$ACCESS_LOG" 2>/dev/null
    fi
    if [[ ! -w "$ACCESS_LOG" ]]; then
        printf 'warning: entry log %s is not writable\n' "$ACCESS_LOG" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$(date '+%F %T')" "$token" "$verdict" "$detail" \
        >> "$ACCESS_LOG"
}

access() {
    local token="$1" zone="$2" profile status dues
    if [[ -z "$token" ]]; then
        printf 'access denied: no token scanned\n'
        return 1
    fi
    profile="$PROFILE_DIR/$token.conf"
    if [[ ! -f "$profile" ]]; then
        printf 'access denied: unknown token %s\n' "$token"
        log_entry "$token" DENIED "no profile"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -s "$profile" ]]; then
        printf 'access denied: empty profile for %s\n' "$token"
        log_entry "$token" DENIED "empty profile"
        return 1
    fi
    status="$(get_field "$profile" status)"
    if [[ "$status" != "active" ]]; then
        printf 'access denied: membership is %s\n' "${status:-unset}"
        log_entry "$token" DENIED "status=${status:-unset}"
        return 1
    fi
    dues="$(get_field "$profile" dues)"
    case "$dues" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) dues=-1 ;;
    esac
    if [[ "$dues" -ne 0 ]]; then
        printf 'access denied: outstanding dues\n'
        log_entry "$token" DENIED "dues=$dues"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$zone" != "pool" ]]; then
        printf 'access denied: turnstile serves the pool zone only\n'
        log_entry "$token" DENIED "zone=$zone"
        return 1
    fi
    printf 'access granted\n'
    log_entry "$token" GRANTED "zone=$zone"
    return 0
}

if [[ "$#" -ne 2 ]]; then
    printf 'usage: %s <token> <zone>\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
fi
access "$1" "$2"

    profile="$PROFILE_DIR/$token.conf"
    if [ ! -f "$profile" ]; then
        printf 'access denied: unknown token %s\n' "$token"
        log_entry "$token" DENIED "no profile"
        return 1
    fi
    if [ ! -s "$profile" ]; then
        printf 'access denied: empty profile for %s\n' "$token"
        log_entry "$token" DENIED "empty profile"
        return 1
    fi
    status="$(get_field "$profile" status)"
    if [ "$status" != "active" ]; then
        printf 'access denied: membership is %s\n' "${status:-unset}"
        log_entry "$token" DENIED "status=${status:-unset}"
        return 1
    fi
    dues="$(get_field "$profile" dues)"
    case "$dues" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) dues=-1 ;;
    esac
    if [ "$dues" -ne 0 ]; then
        printf 'access denied: outstanding dues\n'
        log_entry "$token" DENIED "dues=$dues"
        return 1
    fi
    if [ "$zone" != "pool" ]; then
        printf 'access denied: turnstile serves the pool zone only\n'
        log_entry "$token" DENIED "zone=$zone"
        return 1
    fi
    printf 'access granted\n'
    log_entry "$token" GRANTED "zone=$zone"
    return 0
}

if [ "$#" -ne 2 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s <token> <zone>\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
fi

Check if the waiting cars integer is less than 2. Check if the current light state string is exactly red. Check if the emergency override file exists. Check if the emergency override file is readable. Check if the signal control log is writable. Check if the maintenance string is exactly inactive. Example input: intersection with 12 waiting cars and a red light. Example output: light changed to green.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Traffic signal coordination module.

OVERRIDE_FILE="${OVERRIDE_FILE:-/tmp/traffic_emergency_override}"
CONTROL_LOG="${CONTROL_LOG:-/tmp/signal_control.log}"
MAINTENANCE_MODE="${MAINTENANCE_MODE:-inactive}"

declare -A LIGHTS=( [main-1st]=red [oak-3rd]=green [elm-9th]=yellow )

log_event() {
    local message="$1"
    if [[ -w "$CONTROL_LOG" ]]; then
        printf '%s %s\n' "$(date '+%H:%M:%S')" "$message" >>"$CONTROL_LOG"
    else
        printf 'signal log not writable, dropping: %s\n' "$message" >&2
    fi
}

current_light() {
    local state="${LIGHTS[$1]}"
    if [[ -z "$state" ]]; then
        state="unknown"
    fi
    printf '%s\n' "$state"
}

set_light() {
    LIGHTS["$1"]="$2"
    log_event "$1 set to $2"
}

override_active() {
    if [[ ! -e "$OVERRIDE_FILE" ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -r "$OVERRIDE_FILE" ]]; then
        log_event "override file $OVERRIDE_FILE exists but is unreadable"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

signal() {
    local intersection="$1" cars="$2" state
    if [[ -z "$intersection" ]]; then
        printf 'error: intersection identifier is empty\n' >&2
        return 2
    fi
    case "$cars" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) printf 'error: waiting cars must be a number\n' >&2; return 2 ;;
    esac
    if [[ "$MAINTENANCE_MODE" != "inactive" ]]; then
        log_event "$intersection untouched, maintenance is $MAINTENANCE_MODE"
        printf 'maintenance mode: no change at %s\n' "$intersection"
        return 1
    fi
    state="$(current_light "$intersection")"
    if override_active; then
        set_light "$intersection" "red"
        printf 'emergency override at %s: light forced to red\n' "$intersection"
        return 0
    fi
    if [[ "$cars" -gt 10 ]]; then
        if [[ "$state" == "red" ]]; then
            set_light "$intersection" "green"
            printf 'light changed to green\n'
            return 0
        fi
    elif [[ "$cars" -lt 2 ]]; then
        if [[ "$state" == "green" ]]; then
            set_light "$intersection" "red"
            printf 'light changed to red\n'
            return 0
        fi
    fi
    printf 'light held at %s for %s\n' "$state" "$intersection"
    return 0
}

touch "$CONTROL_LOG" 2>/dev/null
signal "main-1st" 12
signal "oak-3rd" 1
signal "elm-9th" 5
signal "" 4

Check if the volume setting is less than 10. Check if the headset is exactly connected. Example input: exhibit 5 in english with volume 5. Example output: playing exhibit audio.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Interactive museum exhibit guide: validates the request and the playback
# environment before starting the exhibit narration.

set -u

AUDIO_DIR="${EXHIBIT_AUDIO_DIR:-/usr/share/museum/audio}"
VOLUME="${USER_VOLUME:-5}"
HEADSET="${HEADSET_STATE:-connected}"

fail() {
    printf 'guide: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    return 1
}

is_whole_number() {
    case "$1" in
        '' | *[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
    esac
    return 0
}

validate_exhibit() {
    local exhibit="$1"
    is_whole_number "$exhibit" || return 1
    if [[ "$exhibit" -gt 0 ]]; then
        :
    else
        fail "exhibit number must be greater than 0"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$exhibit" -lt 100 ]]; then
        return 0
    fi
    fail "exhibit number must be less than 100"
    return 1
}

validate_language() {
    if [[ "$1" = "english" ]]; then
        return 0
    fi
    fail "only the english narration track is installed"
    return 1
}

audio_path() {
    printf '%s/exhibit-%s.wav' "$AUDIO_DIR" "$1"
}

validate_audio() {
    local track="$1"
    if [[ ! -f "$track" ]]; then
        fail "no audio file for this exhibit: $track"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -r "$track" ]]; then
        fail "audio file is not readable: $track"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

validate_playback() {
    if [[ "$VOLUME" -le 0 ]]; then
        fail "raise the volume above 0 to hear the guide"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$VOLUME" -ge 10 ]]; then
        fail "volume setting must stay below 10"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$HEADSET" != "connected" ]]; then
        fail "headset is $HEADSET; please plug it in"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

guide() {
    local exhibit="$1" language="$2" track
    validate_exhibit "$exhibit" || return 1
    validate_language "$language" || return 1
    track="$(audio_path "$exhibit")"
    validate_audio "$track" || return 1
    validate_playback || return 1
    printf 'playing exhibit audio\n'
}

main() {
    if [[ "$#" -ne 2 ]]; then
        printf 'usage: %s EXHIBIT LANGUAGE\n' "${0##*/}" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    if [[ ! -d "$AUDIO_DIR" ]]; then
        fail "audio library not found at $AUDIO_DIR"
        return 1
    fi
    guide "$1" "$2"
}

main "$@"

text_es: Regulate fish tank conditions by implementing `regulate(tank)`. Check if the tank identifier is not empty. Check if the tank state file exists. Check if the state file is readable. Read the water temperature and check if it is less than 20. Check if the temperature is greater than 28. Check if the fish species string is exactly tropical. Check if the heater status file is writable. Check if the emergency alarm is exactly silent. Example input: tropical tank at 18 degrees. Example output: heater turned on.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fish tank climate regulation: reads a tank state file, decides heater action.

STATE_DIR="${TANK_STATE_DIR:-/tmp/fishtank}"

read_field() {
    local file="$1" key="$2" name value
    while IFS='=' read -r name value; do
        if [[ "$name" = "$key" ]]; then
            printf '%s\n' "$value"
            return 0
        fi
    done < "$file"
    return 1
}

regulate() {
    local tank="$1"
    if [[ -z "$tank" ]]; then
        echo "error: tank identifier is empty" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    local state="$STATE_DIR/$tank.state"
    local heater="$STATE_DIR/$tank.heater"
    if [[ ! -e "$state" ]]; then
        echo "error: no state file for tank '$tank'" >&2
        return 3
    fi
    if [[ ! -r "$state" ]]; then
        echo "error: state file for tank '$tank' is not readable" >&2
        return 4
    fi

    local temp species alarm
    temp="$(read_field "$state" temperature)"
    species="$(read_field "$state" species)"
    alarm="$(read_field "$state" alarm)"

    if [[ -z "$temp" ]]; then
        echo "error: temperature missing in state file" >&2
        return 5
    fi
    if [[ "$alarm" != "silent" ]]; then
        echo "emergency alarm '$alarm': manual intervention required" >&2
        return 6
    fi
    if [[ ! -w "$heater" ]]; then
        echo "error: heater status file is not writable" >&2
        return 7
    fi

    local action="hold"
    if [[ "$temp" -lt 20 ]]; then
        action="heat"
    elif [[ "$temp" -gt 28 ]]; then
        action="cool"
    fi

    case "$action" in
        heat) printf 'on\n' > "$heater"; echo "heater turned on" ;;
        cool) printf 'off\n' > "$heater"; echo "heater turned off, cooling required" ;;
        hold) printf 'off\n' > "$heater"; echo "temperature stable at ${temp}C" ;;
    esac

    if [[ "$species" = "tropical" ]]; then
        if [[ "$temp" -lt 24 ]]; then
            echo "note: tropical fish prefer at least 24C"
        fi
    fi
    return 0
}

main() {
    local tank="${1:-reef01}"
    mkdir -p "$STATE_DIR"
    local state="$STATE_DIR/$tank.state"
    if [[ ! -e "$state" ]]; then
        printf 'species=tropical\ntemperature=18\nalarm=silent\n' > "$state"
    fi
    local heater="$STATE_DIR/$tank.heater"
    if [[ ! -e "$heater" ]]; then
        printf 'off\n' > "$heater"
    fi
    regulate "$tank"
}

main "$@"

text_es: Control industrial bakery ovens using the function `bake(recipe, temp)`. Check if the recipe string is exactly bread. Check if the target temperature is greater than 100. Check if the temperature is less than 300. Check if the oven door sensor file exists. Check if the sensor file contains the exact string closed. Check if the timer duration integer is greater than 0. Check if the power state is exactly on. Check if the cooling fan is exactly off. Example input: bread recipe at 200 degrees with doors closed. Example output: oven started.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Industrial bakery oven controller.

DOOR_SENSOR="${DOOR_SENSOR:-/var/run/oven/door}"
TIMER_MINUTES="${TIMER_MINUTES:-30}"
POWER_STATE="${POWER_STATE:-on}"
COOLING_FAN="${COOLING_FAN:-off}"

log() { printf 'oven: %s\n' "$*" >&2; }

read_door_state() {
    local file="$1"
    if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
        log "door sensor file '$file' not found"
        return 1
    fi
    local state=""
    IFS= read -r state < "$file"
    printf '%s' "$state"
}

is_number() {
    case "$1" in
        ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
    esac
    return 0
}

check_temperature() {
    local temp="$1"
    if ! is_number "$temp"; then
        log "temperature '$temp' is not a whole number"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$temp" -le 100 ]]; then
        log "temperature $temp is not above 100"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$temp" -ge 300 ]]; then
        log "temperature $temp is not below 300"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

check_timer() {
    if ! is_number "$TIMER_MINUTES"; then
        log "timer '$TIMER_MINUTES' is not a whole number"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$TIMER_MINUTES" -lt 1 ]]; then
        log "timer duration must be greater than 0"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

check_power_train() {
    if [[ "$POWER_STATE" != "on" ]]; then
        log "power state is '$POWER_STATE', expected 'on'"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$COOLING_FAN" != "off" ]]; then
        log "cooling fan is '$COOLING_FAN', expected 'off'"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

bake() {
    local recipe="$1" temp="$2" door
    if [[ "$recipe" != "bread" ]]; then
        log "recipe '$recipe' is not supported"
        return 1
    fi
    check_temperature "$temp" || return 1
    door="$(read_door_state "$DOOR_SENSOR")" || return 1
    if [[ "$door" != "closed" ]]; then
        log "oven door reads '$door', expected 'closed'"
        return 1
    fi
    check_timer || return 1
    check_power_train || return 1
    printf 'oven started\n'
    return 0
}

main() {
    local recipe="" temp=""
    while [[ "$#" -gt 0 ]]; do
        case "$1" in
            --door) DOOR_SENSOR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
            --timer) TIMER_MINUTES="$2"; shift 2 ;;
            --power) POWER_STATE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
            --fan) COOLING_FAN="$2"; shift 2 ;;
            *) if [[ -z "$recipe" ]]; then recipe="$1"; else temp="$1"; fi; shift ;;
        esac
    done
    if [[ -z "$temp" ]]; then
        log "usage: $0 RECIPE TEMP [--door FILE] [--timer MIN] [--power on|off] [--fan on|off]"
        return 2
    fi
    bake "$recipe" "$temp"
}

main "$@"

text_es: Dispatch building elevators using the function `dispatch(floor, weight)`. Check if the requested floor is greater than 0. Check if the floor is less than 50. Check if the passenger weight integer is greater than 1000. Check if the door sensor status string is exactly clear. Check if the maintenance override file exists. Check if the elevator status file is writable. Check if the fire alarm state is exactly inactive. Check if the current mode is exactly auto. Example input: floor 10 with weight 500 and doors clear. Example output: elevator dispatched to floor 10.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Elevator dispatch module.

DOOR_SENSOR="${DOOR_SENSOR:-clear}"
FIRE_ALARM="${FIRE_ALARM:-inactive}"
MODE="${MODE:-auto}"
MAINTENANCE_FILE="${MAINTENANCE_FILE:-/var/run/elevator/maintenance.override}"
STATUS_FILE="${STATUS_FILE:-/tmp/elevator.status}"

log() {
    printf '%s\n' "$*" >&2
}

check_floor() {
    local floor="$1"
    if [[ -z "$floor" ]]; then
        log "error: no floor requested"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! "$floor" -gt 0 ]]; then
        log "error: floor $floor is below the lowest served floor"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! "$floor" -lt 50 ]]; then
        log "error: floor $floor is above the highest served floor"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

check_weight() {
    local weight="$1"
    if [[ "$weight" -gt 1000 ]]; then
        log "error: load of ${weight}kg exceeds the 1000kg limit"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

check_doors() {
    if [[ "$DOOR_SENSOR" != "clear" ]]; then
        log "error: door sensor reports '$DOOR_SENSOR'"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

check_safety() {
    if [[ -f "$MAINTENANCE_FILE" ]]; then
        log "error: maintenance override engaged"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -w "$STATUS_FILE" ]]; then
        log "error: status file $STATUS_FILE is not writable"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$FIRE_ALARM" != "inactive" ]]; then
        log "error: fire alarm state is '$FIRE_ALARM'"
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$MODE" != "auto" ]]; then
        log "error: controller is in '$MODE' mode"
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

dispatch() {
    local floor="$1" weight="$2"
    check_floor "$floor" || return 1
    check_weight "$weight" || return 1
    check_doors || return 1
    check_safety || return 1
    printf 'floor=%s weight=%s\n' "$floor" "$weight" >"$STATUS_FILE"
    echo "elevator dispatched to floor $floor"
}

: >"$STATUS_FILE" 2>/dev/null
dispatch "${1:-10}" "${2:-500}"

text_es: Calculate parking fees with the function `calculate(ticket, hours)`. Check if the ticket identifier is not empty. Check if the hours parked integer is greater than 0. Check if the hours parked is less than 48. Check if the vehicle type string is exactly motorcycle. Check if the payment method string is exactly cash. Check if the daily transaction log file exists. Check if the log file is writable. Check if the exit gate is exactly closed. Example input: car parked for 3 hours paying cash. Example output: fee calculated and logged.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Parking fee calculator with daily transaction logging.
set -u

LOG_FILE="${LOG_FILE:-/tmp/parking-$(date +%F).log}"
VEHICLE_TYPE="car"
PAYMENT_METHOD="cash"
EXIT_GATE="closed"

is_integer() {
    case "$1" in
        '' | *[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
        *) return 0 ;;
    esac
}

prepare_log() {
    if [[ ! -e "$LOG_FILE" ]]; then
        : > "$LOG_FILE" || return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -f "$LOG_FILE" ]]; then
        echo "error: $LOG_FILE is not a regular file" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -w "$LOG_FILE" ]]; then
        echo "error: transaction log $LOG_FILE is not writable" >&2
        return 1
    fi
}

hourly_rate_cents() {
    if [[ "$VEHICLE_TYPE" = "motorcycle" ]]; then
        echo 100
    else
        echo 250
    fi
}

apply_payment_discount() {
    local cents="$1"
    if [[ "$PAYMENT_METHOD" = "cash" ]]; then
        cents=$(( cents * 95 / 100 ))
    fi
    echo "$cents"
}

format_amount() {
    printf '%d.%02d\n' "$(( $1 / 100 ))" "$(( $1 % 100 ))"
}

open_exit_gate() {
    if [[ "$EXIT_GATE" = "closed" ]]; then
        EXIT_GATE="open"
        echo "exit gate opened"
    fi
}

calculate() {
    local ticket="$1" hours="$2" rate total amount
    if [[ -z "$ticket" ]]; then
        echo "error: ticket identifier is empty" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if ! is_integer "$hours"; then
        echo "error: hours parked '$hours' is not an integer" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$hours" -le 0 ]]; then
        echo "error: hours parked must be greater than 0" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ "$hours" -ge 48 ]]; then
        echo "error: hours parked must be less than 48" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    prepare_log || return 1
    rate="$(hourly_rate_cents)"
    total="$(apply_payment_discount "$(( rate * hours ))")"
    amount="$(format_amount "$total")"
    printf '%s\t%s\t%sh\t%s\t%s\n' "$(date '+%F %T')" "$ticket" "$hours" \
        "$VEHICLE_TYPE" "$amount" >> "$LOG_FILE"
    echo "ticket $ticket: $VEHICLE_TYPE, ${hours}h, $PAYMENT_METHOD, fee $amount logged"
    open_exit_gate
}

main() {
    local ticket="${1:-A-1001}" hours="${2:-3}"
    if [[ -n "${3:-}" ]]; then
        VEHICLE_TYPE="$3"
    fi
    if [[ -n "${4:-}" ]]; then
        PAYMENT_METHOD="$4"
    fi
    calculate "$ticket" "$hours"
}

main "$@"

text_es: Write a function `digitize(records)`. The input is a text file where each line represents a document record containing a filename, size, pages, year, type, author, condition, and status separated by spaces. Iterate over the lines and evaluate the fields. If the size is exactly zero, append the filename to an empty log. If the pages are greater than five hundred, append to a thick log. If the year is less than nineteen hundred, append to an antique log. If the type is exactly the word manuscript, append to a secure log. If the author is exactly the word anonymous, append to a review log. If the condition is exactly the word poor, append to a restore log. If the status is exactly the word missing, append to an alert log. If the filename is exactly the word index, append to a skip log. Example input is a line with notes zero ten twothousand letter smith good kept. Example output is notes appended to the empty log.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Document digitization triage: read records and route filenames to logs.

declare -a empty_log thick_log antique_log secure_log review_log
declare -a restore_log alert_log skip_log

num_of() {
    local word="$1"
    case "$word" in
        zero)            printf '0' ;;
        ten)             printf '10' ;;
        hundred)         printf '100' ;;
        fivehundred)     printf '500' ;;
        sixhundred)      printf '600' ;;
        eighteenhundred) printf '1800' ;;
        nineteenhundred) printf '1900' ;;
        twothousand)     printf '2000' ;;
        *)
            case "$word" in
                ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
            esac
            printf '%s' "$word" ;;
    esac
}

reject() {
    printf 'line %s: malformed record: %s\n' "$1" "$2" >&2
}

print_log() {
    local name="$1"
    shift
    if [[ "$#" -eq 0 ]]; then
        return 0
    fi
    printf '%s log: %s\n' "$name" "$*"
}

digitize() {
    local records="$1"
    if [[ ! -r "$records" ]]; then
        printf 'digitize: cannot read %s\n' "$records" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    local line filename size pages year type author condition status extra
    local size_n pages_n year_n lineno=0
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        lineno=$((lineno + 1))
        read -r filename size pages year type author condition status extra <<<"$line"
        if [[ -z "$filename" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        if [[ -z "$status" ]]; then
            reject "$lineno" "$line"
            continue
        fi
        if [[ -n "$extra" ]]; then
            reject "$lineno" "$line"
            continue
        fi
        size_n=$(num_of "$size") || { reject "$lineno" "$line"; continue; }
        pages_n=$(num_of "$pages") || { reject "$lineno" "$line"; continue; }
        year_n=$(num_of "$year") || { reject "$lineno" "$line"; continue; }
        if [[ "$size_n" -eq 0 ]]; then
            empty_log+=("$filename")
        fi
        if [[ "$pages_n" -gt 500 ]]; then
            thick_log+=("$filename")
        fi
        if [[ "$year_n" -lt 1900 ]]; then
            antique_log+=("$filename")
        fi
        if [[ "$type" = "manuscript" ]]; then
            secure_log+=("$filename")
        fi
        if [[ "$author" = "anonymous" ]]; then
            review_log+=("$filename")
        fi
        if [[ "$condition" = "poor" ]]; then
            restore_log+=("$filename")
        fi
        if [[ "$status" = "missing" ]]; then
            alert_log+=("$filename")
        fi
        if [[ "$filename" = "index" ]]; then
            skip_log+=("$filename")
        fi
    done <"$records"
    print_log empty "${empty_log[@]}"
    print_log thick "${thick_log[@]}"
    print_log antique "${antique_log[@]}"
    print_log secure "${secure_log[@]}"
    print_log review "${review_log[@]}"
    print_log restore "${restore_log[@]}"
    print_log alert "${alert_log[@]}"
    print_log skip "${skip_log[@]}"
}

if [[ "$#" -ne 1 ]]; then
    printf 'usage: %s RECORDS\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
fi
digitize "$1"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Sensor reading monitor: classifies each reading into one or more logs.

declare -A NUMWORDS=(
    [zero]=0 [five]=5 [ten]=10 [twelve]=12 [fifteen]=15 [eighteen]=18
    [twenty]=20 [ninety]=90 [hundred]=100 [onefive]=105 [oneten]=110
    [onefifteen]=115 [onetwenty]=120 [twoforty]=240 [fivehundred]=500
    [onethousand]=1000 [twothousand]=2000 [threethousand]=3000
)

declare -a off_log high_log low_log trip_log backup_log appliance_log wake_log network_log

to_number() {

The input is a text file where each line is a transaction containing a txid, amount, fee, balance, currency, type, status, and country separated by spaces. Process each transaction line. If the amount is exactly zero, append the txid to a zero log. If the amount is greater than ten thousand, append to a flag log. If the fee is less than one, append to a free log. If the balance is less than zero, append to an overdraft log. If the currency is exactly the word euro, append to a forex log. If the type is exactly the word refund, append to a reversal log. If the status is exactly the word pending, append to a wait log. If the country is exactly the word domestic, append to a local log. Example input is txone zero five hundred usd purchase cleared foreign. Example output is txone appended to the zero log.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Ledger transaction router: dispatches each transaction to the logs it matches.
set -u

LOG_DIR="${LOG_DIR:-./ledger-logs}"

is_integer() {
    local value="$1"
    case "$value" in
        -*) value="${value#-}" ;;
    esac
    case "$value" in
        '' | *[!0-9]*) return 1 ;;
    esac
    return 0
}

log_txid() {
    local log="$1" txid="$2"
    printf '%s\n' "$txid" >> "$LOG_DIR/$log.log"
    printf '%s appended to the %s log\n' "$txid" "$log"
}

validate_record() {
    local lineno="$1" amount="${2-}" fee="${3-}" balance="${4-}" count="${5-}"
    if [[ "$count" -ne 8 ]]; then
        printf 'line %s: expected 8 fields, found %s\n' "$lineno" "$count" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if ! is_integer "$amount"; then
        printf 'line %s: amount is not a number: %s\n' "$lineno" "$amount" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if ! is_integer "$fee"; then
        printf 'line %s: fee is not a number: %s\n' "$lineno" "$fee" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if ! is_integer "$balance"; then
        printf 'line %s: balance is not a number: %s\n' "$lineno" "$balance" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

classify_record() {
    local txid="$1" amount="$2" fee="$3" balance="$4"
    local currency="$5" kind="$6" status="$7" country="$8"
    if [[ "$amount" -eq 0 ]]; then log_txid zero "$txid"; fi
    if [[ "$amount" -gt 10000 ]]; then log_txid flag "$txid"; fi
    if [[ "$fee" -lt 1 ]]; then log_txid free "$txid"; fi
    if [[ "$balance" -lt 0 ]]; then log_txid overdraft "$txid"; fi
    if [[ "$currency" = "euro" ]]; then log_txid forex "$txid"; fi
    if [[ "$kind" = "refund" ]]; then log_txid reversal "$txid"; fi
    if [[ "$status" = "pending" ]]; then log_txid wait "$txid"; fi
    if [[ "$country" = "domestic" ]]; then log_txid local "$txid"; fi
}

process() {
    local ledger="$1"
    if [[ ! -f "$ledger" ]]; then
        printf 'process: no such ledger file: %s\n' "$ledger" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ ! -r "$ledger" ]]; then
        printf 'process: ledger file is not readable: %s\n' "$ledger" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" || return 1
    local lineno=0 accepted=0 rejected=0 line
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        lineno=$((lineno + 1))
        set -- $line
        if [[ "$#" -eq 0 ]]; then continue; fi
        if ! validate_record "$lineno" "${2-}" "${3-}" "${4-}" "$#"; then
            rejected=$((rejected + 1))
            continue
        fi
        classify_record "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$5" "$6" "$7" "$8"
        accepted=$((accepted + 1))
    done < "$ledger"
    printf 'processed %s transaction(s), rejected %s line(s)\n' "$accepted" "$rejected"
    if [[ "$rejected" -gt 0 ]]; then return 1; fi
    return 0
}

main() {
    if [[ "$#" -ne 1 ]]; then
        printf 'usage: %s <ledger-file>\n' "$0" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    process "$1"
}

main "$@"

Read the file to categorize the records. If the duration is exactly zero, append the client to a query log. If the duration is greater than forty, append to an overtime log. If the rate is less than fifteen, append to a minimum log. If the tax is greater than twenty, append to an audit log. If the status is exactly the word paid, append to a closed log. If the method is exactly the word wire, append to a bank log. If the priority is exactly the word high, append to a rush log. If the department is exactly the word design, append to a creative log. Example input is acme zero twenty ten unpaid cash low sales. Example output is acme appended to the query log.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# invoice: categorize work records from a whitespace separated text file.
set -uo pipefail

declare -A WORD_NUM=(
    [zero]=0 [one]=1 [two]=2 [three]=3 [four]=4 [five]=5
    [six]=6 [seven]=7 [eight]=8 [nine]=9 [ten]=10 [twelve]=12
    [fifteen]=15 [eighteen]=18 [twenty]=20 [twentyfive]=25
    [thirty]=30 [forty]=40 [fortyfive]=45 [fifty]=50 [sixty]=60
)
declare -A LOG_COUNT=()

to_num() {
    local token="${1,,}" value
    value="${WORD_NUM[$token]:-}"
    if [[ -n "$value" ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$value"
        return 0
    fi
    case "$token" in ''|*[!0-9]*) return 1 ;; esac
    printf '%s\n' "$token"
}

append_log() {
    local log="$1" client="$2"
    LOG_COUNT["$log"]=$(( ${LOG_COUNT["$log"]:-0} + 1 ))
    printf '%s\n' "$client" >> "$LOG_DIR/$log.log"
    printf '%s appended to the %s log\n' "$client" "$log"
}

invoice() {
    local hours="$1" client duration rate tax status method priority department extra
    local dnum rnum tnum
    if [[ ! -r "$hours" ]]; then
        printf 'invoice: cannot read %s\n' "$hours" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    LOG_DIR="${INVOICE_LOG_DIR:-.}"
    if [[ ! -d "$LOG_DIR" ]]; then
        mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" || return 1
    fi
    while read -r client duration rate tax status method priority department extra; do
        if [[ -z "$client" ]]; then continue; fi
        if [[ -z "$department" ]]; then
            printf 'invoice: incomplete record for %s\n' "$client" >&2
            continue
        fi
        if [[ -n "$extra" ]]; then
            printf 'invoice: extra fields in record for %s\n' "$client" >&2
            continue
        fi
        dnum=$(to_num "$duration") && rnum=$(to_num "$rate") && tnum=$(to_num "$tax") || {
            printf 'invoice: bad number in record for %s\n' "$client" >&2
            continue
        }
        if [[ "$dnum" -eq 0 ]]; then append_log query "$client"; fi
        if [[ "$dnum" -gt 40 ]]; then append_log overtime "$client"; fi
        if [[ "$rnum" -lt 15 ]]; then append_log minimum "$client"; fi
        if [[ "$tnum" -gt 20 ]]; then append_log audit "$client"; fi
        if [[ "$status" = "paid" ]]; then append_log closed "$client"; fi
        if [[ "$method" = "wire" ]]; then append_log bank "$client"; fi
        if [[ "$priority" = "high" ]]; then append_log rush "$client"; fi
        if [[ "$department" = "design" ]]; then append_log creative "$client"; fi
    done < "$hours"
}

summary() {
    local log count
    for log in query overtime minimum audit closed bank rush creative; do
        count="${LOG_COUNT[$log]:-0}"
        if [[ "$count" -gt 0 ]]; then
            printf '%-9s %s\n' "$log" "$count"
        fi
    done
}

main() {
    if [[ "$#" -ne 1 ]]; then
        printf 'usage: %s HOURS_FILE\n' "$0" >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    invoice "$1" || exit 1
    summary
}

if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" = "$0" ]]; then
    main "$@"
fi

text_es: Write a function `proctor(events)`. The input is a text file where each line is an exam event containing a student, warnings, score, duration, webcam, mic, screen, and network separated by spaces. Evaluate the events line by line. If the warnings are greater than three, append the student to a terminate log. If the warnings are exactly zero, append to a perfect log. If the score is less than fifty, append to a fail log. If the duration is greater than one hundred twenty, append to a timeout log. If the webcam is exactly the word off, append to a blind log. If the mic is exactly the word muted, append to a deaf log. If the screen is exactly the word hidden, append to a cheat log. If the network is exactly the word offline, append to a drop log. Example input is jane four ninety sixty on live visible online. Example output is jane appended to the terminate log.

word_class() {
    case "$1" in
        zero) echo zero ;;
        one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine) echo unit ;;
        ten|eleven|twelve|thirteen|fourteen|fifteen|sixteen|seventeen|eighteen|nineteen) echo teen ;;
        twenty|thirty|forty|fifty|sixty|seventy|eighty|ninety) echo ten ;;
        hundred|thousand) echo scale ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

word_value() {
    case "$1" in
        zero) echo 0 ;; one) echo 1 ;; two) echo 2 ;; three) echo 3 ;;
        four) echo 4 ;; five) echo 5 ;; six) echo 6 ;; seven) echo 7 ;;
        eight) echo 8 ;; nine) echo 9 ;; ten) echo 10 ;; eleven) echo 11 ;;
        twelve) echo 12 ;; thirteen) echo 13 ;; fourteen) echo 14 ;; fifteen) echo 15 ;;
        sixteen) echo 16 ;; seventeen) echo 17 ;; eighteen) echo 18 ;; nineteen) echo 19 ;;
        twenty) echo 20 ;; thirty) echo 30 ;; forty) echo 40 ;; fifty) echo 50 ;;
        sixty) echo 60 ;; seventy) echo 70 ;; eighty) echo 80 ;; ninety) echo 90 ;;
        hundred) echo 100 ;; thousand) echo 1000 ;;
        *) return 1 ;;
    esac
}

words_to_number() {
    local w v total=0 cur=0
    for w in "$@"; do
        v=$(word_value "$w") || return 1
        if [[ "$v" -eq 100 ]]; then
            if [[ "$cur" -eq 0 ]]; then cur=1; fi
            cur=$(( cur * 100 ))
        elif [[ "$v" -eq 1000 ]]; then
            if [[ "$cur" -eq 0 ]]; then cur=1; fi
            total=$(( total + cur * 1000 )); cur=0
        else
            cur=$(( cur + v ))
        fi
    done
    echo $(( total + cur ))
}

split_numbers() {
    local w cls prev="" fresh
    local -a group=()
    for w in "$@"; do
        cls=$(word_class "$w") || return 1
        fresh=1
        if [[ "${#group[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then fresh=0
        elif [[ "$cls" = scale ]]; then fresh=0
        elif [[ "$prev" = scale ]]; then fresh=0
        elif [[ "$prev" = ten ]]; then
            if [[ "$cls" = unit ]]; then fresh=0; fi
        fi
        if [[ "$fresh" -eq 1 ]]; then
            words_to_number "${group[@]}" || return 1
            group=("$w")
        else
            group+=("$w")
        fi
        prev="$cls"
    done
    if [[ "${#group[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then words_to_number "${group[@]}" || return 1; fi
}

proctor() {
    local events="$1" line lineno=0 n student webcam mic screen network numbers
    local warnings score duration
    local -a tokens numtokens nums
    if [[ ! -f "$events" ]]; then
        echo "proctor: no such events file: $events" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    while IFS= read -r line || [[ -n "$line" ]]; do
        lineno=$(( lineno + 1 ))
        read -r -a tokens <<< "$line"
        if [[ "${#tokens[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then continue; fi
        if [[ "${#tokens[@]}" -lt 8 ]]; then
            echo "proctor: line $lineno: incomplete event" >&2
            continue
        fi
        n="${#tokens[@]}"
        student="${tokens[0]}"

Read each credential line. If the age is greater than ninety, append the key to an expire log. If the age is exactly zero, append to a new log. If the bits are less than two thousand forty eight, append to a weak log. If the uses are greater than ten thousand, append to an active log. If the algorithm is exactly the word des, append to an obsolete log. If the status is exactly the word revoked, append to a block log. If the owner is exactly the word root, append to an admin log. If the environment is exactly the word prod, append to a live log. Example input is keyone hundred fourthousand five aes active user dev. Example output is keyone appended to the expire log.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Credential rotation triage: classify each credential line into report logs.

EXPIRE_LOG="expire.log"
NEW_LOG="new.log"
WEAK_LOG="weak.log"
ACTIVE_LOG="active.log"
OBSOLETE_LOG="obsolete.log"
BLOCK_LOG="block.log"
ADMIN_LOG="admin.log"
LIVE_LOG="live.log"

is_number() {
    local value="$1"
    local digits="${value//[0-9]/}"
    if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    if [[ -n "$digits" ]]; then
        return 1
    fi
    return 0
}

classify() {
    local key="$1" age="$2" bits="$3" uses="$4" algo="$5" status="$6" owner="$7" env="$8"
    if [[ "$age" -gt 90 ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$key" >>"$EXPIRE_LOG"
        printf '%s appended to the expire log\n' "$key"
    fi
    if [[ "$age" -eq 0 ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$key" >>"$NEW_LOG"
        printf '%s appended to the new log\n' "$key"
    fi
    if [[ "$bits" -lt 2048 ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$key" >>"$WEAK_LOG"
        printf '%s appended to the weak log\n' "$key"
    fi
    if [[ "$uses" -gt 10000 ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$key" >>"$ACTIVE_LOG"
        printf '%s appended to the active log\n' "$key"
    fi
    if [[ "$algo" = "des" ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$key" >>"$OBSOLETE_LOG"
        printf '%s appended to the obsolete log\n' "$key"
    fi
    if [[ "$status" = "revoked" ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$key" >>"$BLOCK_LOG"
        printf '%s appended to the block log\n' "$key"
    fi
    if [[ "$owner" = "root" ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$key" >>"$ADMIN_LOG"
        printf '%s appended to the admin log\n' "$key"
    fi
    if [[ "$env" = "prod" ]]; then
        printf '%s\n' "$key" >>"$LIVE_LOG"
        printf '%s appended to the live log\n' "$key"
    fi
}

rotate() {
    local keys="$1"
    local lineno=0
    if [[ ! -r "$keys" ]]; then
        printf 'rotate: cannot read %s\n' "$keys" >&2
        return 1
    fi
    local key age bits uses algo status owner env extra
    while read -r key age bits uses algo status owner env extra; do
        lineno=$((lineno + 1))
        if [[ -z "$key" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        if [[ -n "$extra" ]]; then
            printf 'rotate: line %d has extra fields\n' "$lineno" >&2
            continue
        fi
        if [[ -z "$env" ]]; then
            printf 'rotate: line %d is incomplete\n' "$lineno" >&2
            continue
        fi
        if ! is_number "$age"; then
            printf 'rotate: line %d has a bad age\n' "$lineno" >&2
            continue
        fi
        if ! is_number "$bits"; then
            printf 'rotate: line %d has bad bits\n' "$lineno" >&2
            continue
        fi
        if ! is_number "$uses"; then
            printf 'rotate: line %d has bad uses\n' "$lineno" >&2
            continue
        fi
        classify "$key" "$age" "$bits" "$uses" "$algo" "$status" "$owner" "$env"
    done <"$keys"
}

if [[ "$#" -ne 1 ]]; then
    printf 'usage: %s KEYFILE\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 2
fi
rotate "$1"

text_es: Write a function `screen(applicants)`. The input is a text file where each line is a candidate profile containing a candidate, experience, score, gaps, education, visa, referral, and relocation separated by spaces. Review each profile line by line. If the experience is less than two, append the candidate to a junior log. If the experience is greater than ten, append to a senior log. If the score is less than seventy, append to a reject log. If the gaps are greater than three, append to a review log. If the education is exactly the word none, append to a self log. If the visa is exactly the word required, append to a legal log. If the referral is exactly the word yes, append to a priority log. If the relocation is exactly the word yes, append to a move log. Example input is jane one eighty zero bachelor none no no. Example output is jane appended to the junior log.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Applicant screening: read profiles and dispatch each candidate to the
# logs that its fields call for.
set -u

LOGDIR=${LOGDIR:-.}

declare -A NUMWORDS=(
  [zero]=0 [one]=1 [two]=2 [three]=3 [four]=4 [five]=5 [six]=6 [seven]=7
  [eight]=8 [nine]=9 [ten]=10 [eleven]=11 [twelve]=12 [thirteen]=13
  [fourteen]=14 [fifteen]=15 [sixteen]=16 [seventeen]=17 [eighteen]=18
  [nineteen]=19 [twenty]=20 [thirty]=30 [forty]=40 [fifty]=50 [sixty]=60
  [seventy]=70 [eighty]=80 [ninety]=90 [hundred]=100
)

warn() { printf 'screen: %s\n' "$1" >&2; }

# Turn a field such as 3, eighty or seventy-five into a plain integer.
to_number() {
  local token=${1,,}
  if [[ -z "$token" ]]; then return 1; fi
  local stripped=${token//[0-9]/}
  if [[ -z "$stripped" ]]; then printf '%s\n' "$((10#$token))"; return 0; fi
  local total=0 part parts
  IFS='-' read -r -a parts <<< "$token"
  for part in "${parts[@]}"; do
    if [[ -z "${NUMWORDS[$part]+set}" ]]; then return 1; fi
    total=$(( total + NUMWORDS[$part] ))
  done
  printf '%s\n' "$total"
}

log_append() {
  local log=$1 candidate=$2
  printf '%s\n' "$candidate" >> "$LOGDIR/$log.log"
  printf '%s appended to the %s log\n' "$candidate" "$log"
}

screen() {
  local applicants=$1
  if [[ ! -r "$applicants" ]]; then
    warn "cannot read $applicants"
    return 1
  fi
  local cand='' exp='' score='' gaps='' edu='' visa='' ref='' reloc='' extra=''
  local e s g lineno=0
  while read -r cand exp score gaps edu visa ref reloc extra || [[ -n "$cand" ]]; do
    lineno=$(( lineno + 1 ))
    if [[ -z "$cand" ]]; then continue; fi
    if [[ -z "$reloc" ]]; then
      warn "line $lineno: incomplete profile"
      continue
    fi
    if [[ -n "$extra" ]]; then warn "line $lineno: extra fields ignored"; fi
    if ! e=$(to_number "$exp"); then warn "line $lineno: bad experience"; continue; fi
    if ! s=$(to_number "$score"); then warn "line $lineno: bad score"; continue; fi
    if ! g=$(to_number "$gaps"); then warn "line $lineno: bad gaps"; continue; fi
    if [[ "$e" -lt 2 ]]; then log_append junior "$cand"; fi
    if [[ "$e" -gt 10 ]]; then log_append senior "$cand"; fi
    if [[ "$s" -lt 70 ]]; then log_append reject "$cand"; fi
    if [[ "$g" -gt 3 ]]; then log_append review "$cand"; fi
    if [[ "${edu,,}" = "none" ]]; then log_append self "$cand"; fi
    if [[ "${visa,,}" = "required" ]]; then log_append legal "$cand"; fi
    if [[ "${ref,,}" = "yes" ]]; then log_append priority "$cand"; fi
    if [[ "${reloc,,}" = "yes" ]]; then log_append move "$cand"; fi
    cand=''
  done < "$applicants"
}

main() {
  if [[ "$#" -ne 1 ]]; then
    printf 'usage: %s applicants-file\n' "$0" >&2
    return 2
  fi
  screen "$1"
}

main "$@"

  [fourteen]=14 [fifteen]=15 [sixteen]=16 [seventeen]=17 [eighteen]=18
  [nineteen]=19 [twenty]=20 [thirty]=30 [forty]=40 [fifty]=50 [sixty]=60
  [seventy]=70 [eighty]=80 [ninety]=90 [hundred]=100
)

warn() { printf 'screen: %s\n' "$1" >&2; }

# Turn a field such as 3, eighty or seventy-five into a plain integer.
to_number() {
  local token=${1,,}
  if [ -z "$token" ]; then return 1; fi
  local stripped=${token//[0-9]/}
  if [ -z "$stripped" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$((10#$token))"; return 0; fi
  local total=0 part parts
  IFS='-' read -r -a parts <<< "$token"
  for part in "${parts[@]}"; do
    if [ -z "${NUMWORDS[$part]+set}" ]; then return 1; fi
    total=$(( total + NUMWORDS[$part] ))
  done
  printf '%s\n' "$total"
}

log_append() {
  local log=$1 candidate=$2
  printf '%s\n' "$candidate" >> "$LOGDIR/$log.log"
  printf '%s appended to the %s log\n' "$candidate" "$log"
}

screen() {
  local applicants=$1
  if [ ! -r "$applicants" ]; then
    warn "cannot read $applicants"
    return 1
  fi
  local cand='' exp='' score='' gaps='' edu='' visa='' ref='' reloc='' extra=''
  local e s g lineno=0
  while read -r cand exp score gaps edu visa ref reloc extra || [ -n "$cand" ]; do
    lineno=$(( lineno + 1 ))
    if [ -z "$cand" ]; then continue; fi
    if [ -z "$reloc" ]; then
      warn "line $lineno: incomplete profile"
      continue
    fi
    if [ -n "$extra" ]; then warn "line $lineno: extra fields ignored"; fi
    if ! e=$(to_number "$exp"); then warn "line $lineno: bad experience"; continue; fi
    if ! s=$(to_number "$score"); then warn "line $lineno: bad score"; continue; fi
    if ! g=$(to_number "$gaps"); then warn "line $lineno: bad gaps"; continue; fi
    if [ "$e" -lt 2 ]; then log_append junior "$cand"; fi
    if [ "$e" -gt 10 ]; then log_append senior "$cand"; fi
    if [ "$s" -lt 70 ]; then log_append reject "$cand"; fi
    if [ "$g" -gt 3 ]; then log_append review "$cand"; fi
    if [ "${edu,,}" = "none" ]; then log_append self "$cand"; fi
    if [ "${visa,,}" = "required" ]; then log_append legal "$cand"; fi
    if [ "${ref,,}" = "yes" ]; then log_append priority "$cand"; fi
    if [ "${reloc,,}" = "yes" ]; then log_append move "$cand"; fi
    cand=''
  done < "$applicants"
}

main() {
  if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then

  fi
  screen "$1"

main "$@"

If the miles are greater than ten thousand, append the vehicle to a service log. If the miles are exactly zero, append to a parked log. If the oil is less than twenty, append to a fluid log. If the tires are less than thirty, append to a rubber log. If the brakes are exactly the word poor, append to a stop log. If the engine is exactly the word knocking, append to a major log. If the transmission is exactly the word slipping, append to a gear log. If the body is exactly the word dented, append to a cosmetic log. Example input is truckone twelvethousand fifty fifty good quiet smooth clean. Example output is truckone appended to the service log.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Fleet maintenance triage: read vehicle statuses and dispatch them to logs.

declare -A NUMBER_WORDS=(
  [zero]=0 [one]=1 [two]=2 [three]=3 [four]=4 [five]=5 [six]=6
  [seven]=7 [eight]=8 [nine]=9 [ten]=10 [eleven]=11 [twelve]=12
  [fifteen]=15 [twenty]=20 [thirty]=30 [forty]=40 [fifty]=50
  [sixty]=60 [seventy]=70 [eighty]=80 [ninety]=90 [hundred]=100
)

word_value() {
  local word="$1" multiplier=1 base value
  case "$word" in
    ""|*[!0-9]*) ;;
    *) printf '%s\n' "$((10#$word))"; return 0 ;;
  esac
  if [[ -z "$word" ]]; then return 1; fi
  base="${word%thousand}"
  if [[ "$base" != "$word" ]]; then
    multiplier=1000
    if [[ -z "$base" ]]; then base="one"; fi
  fi
  value="${NUMBER_WORDS[$base]}"
  if [[ -z "$value" ]]; then return 1; fi
  printf '%s\n' "$((value * multiplier))"
}

report() {
  local name="$1" vehicle
  shift
  for vehicle in "$@"; do
    printf '%s appended to the %s log\n' "$vehicle" "$name"
  done
}

maintain() {
  local fleet="$1"
  if [[ ! -r "$fleet" ]]; then
    printf 'maintain: cannot read %s\n' "$fleet" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  local service=() parked=() fluid=() rubber=() stop=() major=() gear=() cosmetic=()
  local vehicle miles oil tires brakes engine transmission body extra
  local lineno=0 m o t
  while read -r vehicle miles oil tires brakes engine transmission body extra; do
    lineno=$((lineno + 1))
    if [[ -z "$vehicle" ]]; then continue; fi
    if [[ -z "$body" ]]; then
      printf 'maintain: line %s: incomplete status\n' "$lineno" >&2
      continue
    fi
    if [[ -n "$extra" ]]; then
      printf 'maintain: line %s: extra fields ignored\n' "$lineno" >&2
    fi
    if ! m=$(word_value "$miles"); then
      printf 'maintain: line %s: bad mileage %s\n' "$lineno" "$miles" >&2
      continue
    fi
    if ! o=$(word_value "$oil"); then
      printf 'maintain: line %s: bad oil level %s\n' "$lineno" "$oil" >&2
      continue
    fi
    if ! t=$(word_value "$tires"); then
      printf 'maintain: line %s: bad tire level %s\n' "$lineno" "$tires" >&2
      continue
    fi
    if [[ "$m" -gt 10000 ]]; then service+=("$vehicle"); fi
    if [[ "$m" -eq 0 ]]; then parked+=("$vehicle"); fi
    if [[ "$o" -lt 20 ]]; then fluid+=("$vehicle"); fi
    if [[ "$t" -lt 30 ]]; then rubber+=("$vehicle"); fi
    if [[ "$brakes" = "poor" ]]; then stop+=("$vehicle"); fi
    if [[ "$engine" = "knocking" ]]; then major+=("$vehicle"); fi
    if [[ "$transmission" = "slipping" ]]; then gear+=("$vehicle"); fi
    if [[ "$body" = "dented" ]]; then cosmetic+=("$vehicle"); fi
  done < "$fleet"
  report service "${service[@]}"
  report parked "${parked[@]}"
  report fluid "${fluid[@]}"
  report rubber "${rubber[@]}"
  report stop "${stop[@]}"
  report major "${major[@]}"
  report gear "${gear[@]}"
  report cosmetic "${cosmetic[@]}"
}

if [[ "$#" -ne 1 ]]; then
  printf 'usage: %s FLEET_FILE\n' "$0" >&2
  exit 2
fi
maintain "$1"

text_es: Write a function `reward(customers)`. The input is a text file where each line is a user account containing a customer, points, spend, returns, tier, status, email, and phone separated by spaces. Read the accounts one by one. If the points are less than zero, append the customer to a debt log. If the points are greater than five thousand, append to a platinum log. If the spend is greater than one thousand, append to a whale log. If the returns are greater than ten, append to a warning log. If the tier is exactly the word silver, append to a mid log. If the status is exactly the word banned, append to an ignore log. If the email is exactly the word missing, append to a contact log. If the phone is exactly the word international, append to a toll log. Example input is bob negative hundred zero bronze active present local. Example output is bob appended to the debt log.
text_nat:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reward-program account scanner: classifies customer accounts into log lists.

declare -a DEBT_LOG=() PLATINUM_LOG=() WHALE_LOG=() WARNING_LOG=()
declare -a MID_LOG=() IGNORE_LOG=() CONTACT_LOG=() TOLL_LOG=()

NUMBER_WORDS="negative:-1 zero:0 ten:10 hundred:100 thousand:1000 million:1000000"

to_number() {
    local token="$1" pair
    case "$token" in
        ''|*[!0-9-]*) ;;
        *) printf '%s\n' "$token"; return 0 ;;
    esac
    for pair in $NUMBER_WORDS; do
        if [[ "$token" == "${pair%%:*}" ]]; then
            printf '%s\n' "${pair#*:}"
            return 0
        fi
    done
    return 1
}

log_customer() {
    local name="$1" log="$2"
    local -n entries="${log^^}_LOG"
    entries+=("$name")
    printf '%s appended to the %s log\n' "$name" "$log"
}

reward() {
    local customers="$1"
    if [[ -z "$customers" ]]; then
        printf 'reward: no account file given\n' >&2
        return 2
    fi
    if [[ ! -r "$customers" ]]; then
        printf 'reward: cannot read %s\n' "$customers" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    local name points spend returns tier status email phone extra
    local lineno=0 p s r
    while IFS=' ' read -r name points spend returns tier status email phone extra; do
        lineno=$((lineno + 1))
        if [[ -z "$name" ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        if [[ -z "$phone" ]]; then
            printf 'reward: line %d has too few fields\n' "$lineno" >&2
            continue
        fi
        if [[ -n "$extra" ]]; then
            printf 'reward: line %d has too many fields\n' "$lineno" >&2
            continue
        fi
        p=$(to_number "$points") || { printf 'reward: bad points on line %d\n' "$lineno" >&2; continue; }
        s=$(to_number "$spend") || { printf 'reward: bad spend on line %d\n' "$lineno" >&2; continue; }
        r=$(to_number "$returns") || { printf 'reward: bad returns on line %d\n' "$lineno" >&2; continue; }
        if [[ "$p" -lt 0 ]]; then
            log_customer "$name" debt
        fi
        if [[ "$p" -gt 5000 ]]; then
            log_customer "$name" platinum
        fi
        if [[ "$s" -gt 1000 ]]; then
            log_customer "$name" whale
        fi
        if [[ "$r" -gt 10 ]]; then
            log_customer "$name" warning
        fi
        if [[ "$tier" == "silver" ]]; then
            log_customer "$name" mid
        fi
        if [[ "$status" == "banned" ]]; then
            log_customer "$name" ignore
        fi
        if [[ "$email" == "missing" ]]; then
            log_customer "$name" contact
        fi
        if [[ "$phone" == "international" ]]; then
            log_customer "$name" toll
        fi
    done < "$customers"
}

report() {
    local log name
    for log in debt platinum whale warning mid ignore contact toll; do
        local -n log_ref="${log^^}_LOG"
        if [[ "${#log_ref[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
            continue
        fi
        printf '%s log (%d):' "$log" "${#log_ref[@]}"
        for name in "${log_ref[@]}"; do
            printf ' %s' "$name"
        done
        printf '\n'
    done
}

main() {
    if [[ "$#" -ne 1 ]]; then
        printf 'usage: %s <accounts-file>\n' "$0" >&2
        return 2
    fi
    reward "$1" || return "$?"
    report
}

main "$@"
